doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Instrument sponsorship and being happy for others
summary: He has no instrument sponsor, plans to buy a Selmer soprano, and says he is happy when others get breaks.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Are you sponsored by a particular music instrument company right now?
No. I got to make a call. You know. I'm not sponsored by any company, but I'm going to make a call to Stan Garver (phonetic sp.). A sell man. I want to talk to him, cause I need a soprano.
I going to get a sell man. You know. Now some other people have approached me, I mean I got to – But I want to use the sell man. I'm not going to say anything just yet.

I understand. The only reason I brought it up is that sometimes when these packages, tour packages and festival packages are being put together, sometimes record companies or instrument companies or other sponsors that are involved, if they have any say in it they bring in certain artists that are part of what they do. You know. And if you're not with one of those –
A guy called me and he hasn't played in a long time. And he's just getting back and he's (Indiscernible) the book from Jamie and Pasal (phonetic sp.) so he can play. All right.

And a company is sponsoring him. Like they're endorsing him. They gave him instruments and everything. You know what I mean? See? Yup. Because he was in an orchestra years ago, and they remember when he was in orchestra. But I was in an orchestra years ago too. [laughs]
But then see, like I tell my honey. I said, "You know. I don't like to say that, because
anybody who gets a break I'm happy for them." You know.

And if they get one, I've got breaks too. Look, I got a wonderful wife, a wonderful family. You know. So, I'm blessed. You know what I mean? So I can't say, "Well, how come that can't happen to me." Hey, man. You know. I'm lucky. I just need to fight this. That's all.
